summary: odh-cli is a Kubernetes component. with 1397 operator config constants (14 image references, 2 env vars). integrates with KServe, Kueue, management relationship via labels/annotations. deploys OAuth proxy sidecar for authentication. references components: data-science-pipelines (import, provider), kserve (import, provider), kueue (import, provider), llama-stack (import, provider), model-registry (import, provider), notebooks (import), opendatahub-operator (import), trainer (import), training-operator (import, provider).
repository_description: CLI tool for RHOAI (Red Hat OpenShift AI) for interacting with RHOAI deployments on Kubernetes.
